title: The Apple AirPods Max are $100 off at Amazon
excerpt:
Save $100: As of June 10, the Apple AirPods Max are available at Amazon for $449, netting you an 18% discount from their usual $549 price tag.

We expect Apple's World Wide Developer Conference (WWDC) to focus mainly on software, but we have good news for the fans of Apple hardware — the AirPods Max just went on sale for a nice discount once again.
